Open the [saved-search prototype](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=saved-search). Select **Save this search**, keep the name **Accessible design**, and save it. After the ordinary library returns, select **Accessible design** under Saved searches in the sidebar and confirm that the same combined conditions and result return with one click.

I’ve assumed a saved search stores its conditions—not a frozen result list—so future bookmarks that match those conditions will appear automatically.
